seo.title: About Us — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) is a nonprofit empowering youth and women in Masoro, Rwanda through literacy, health, and entrepreneurship.

hero.title: About Isôoko
hero.subtitle: Rooted in Masoro, serving the community since 2019

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: From a learning center to a community movement
story.body1: In 2019, the Masoro Learning and Sports Center (MLSC) was founded to address the lack of community resources in Masoro Sector — a peri-urban area in Rulindo District with limited access to learning centers, sports facilities, and computers. Between 2019 and 2021, MLSC implemented five programs: Digital Literacy, Library Access, Health, Sports & Recreation, and Leadership & Empowerment.
story.body2: The success of these programs revealed the need for a more sustainable entity to carry on the mission. Thus, Isôoko Community Development (ICD) was born. Today, ICD operates from the Isôoko Community Center — a hub featuring sports facilities, a computer lab, a library, and office spaces that support educational and recreational activities for the entire community.
story.body3: Masoro is just the starting point. We envision reaching every corner of Rwanda, equipping our people — especially women and youth — with the resources, skills, and confidence they need to thrive. Because when one voice rises, it inspires another.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To cultivate inclusive growth and opportunities, for both women and youth through enhanced health & wellbeing, literacy and entrepreneurship.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: A nation where all Rwandans are equipped with the skills and resources that empower them to realize their full potential.
